title: Issue #3133: Use placeholder attribute for placeholder text.
note: The related placeholder issue #3133 is fixed in this fork.

title: Speed up rendering when there are lot of select choen
note: Replacing .html() with .text() would render escaped entities literally and discard intentional selected optgroup markup; the patch does not change result rendering.

title: Add testing
note: This patch adds tests to the old Grunt and QUnit setup; the fork now has maintained Jasmine, core, and browser suites across four editions.

title: support options with labels only
note: Label-only native options now display and search correctly in the classic and Vanilla editions while retaining source select values; React already accepts structured labels.

title: include special character with insensitive search
note: The shared matcher already folds accented characters for case-insensitive search. The upstream patch also discards its replace() result, so it would not apply its proposed folding.

title: correctly show/hide when used inside shadow DOM
note: Both classic adapters bind outside-click handling to getRootNode() when available; upstream issue #3031 is also marked covered.

title: form_field_jq.hide(...).after is not a function
note: The jQuery adapter hides the source select and inserts the Chosen container in separate operations, avoiding the reported .hide(...).after failure.

title: Colors moved to variables in SCSS
note: Sass colors are configurable through !default variables and CSS custom properties; see fork PR #150 and Harvest issue #3053.

title: Updated "prism.js" to un-minified v1.15.0 (Closes: #3005)
note: The docs bundle includes Prism source, its license, and a source URL file; no historical Prism 1.15.0 upgrade is needed.

title: Change setup documentation
note: Current README and demo setup sections explain package installation and distributed assets. The Visual Studio metadata in this old patch is not needed.

title: Remove 100ms lag on blur by using custom blur and focus events.
note: The classic adapters now schedule their blur check on the next event loop turn rather than waiting 100 ms. Keyboard focus loss closes promptly; existing label-press and touch behavior remains covered by tests.

title: Resolve 1901 issue
note: The one-line patch changes only single-deselect eligibility from blank text to blank value; it does not address #1901's mobile placeholder display. The fork supports touch controls and keeps the first truly blank option as the clear target, avoiding a visible empty-value option being treated as an implicit placeholder.

title: Make hide_results_on_select option apply for deselecting as well
note: Choice removal in both classic adapters already honors hide_results_on_select.

title: Add `option` class passthrough for multi-select
note: The opt-in inherit_option_classes setting copies source option classes to selected chips across the maintained editions.

title: Use the placeholder attribute instead of faking it with value.
note: Both classic adapters set the multiple-search input's native placeholder attribute, matching the behavior tracked in Harvest #3133.

title: Support hidden property on option and optgroup elements.
note: The parser records hidden options and optgroups; the result matcher excludes them and selection guards reject hidden options.

title: Refactor jasmine tests
note: The proposed historical Jasmine migration no longer matches the fork test tree, which already has shared core and adapter coverage.

title: Add new option: search_word_boundary
note: Configurable Unicode-aware word boundaries may help languages where JavaScript regex word boundaries split accented words. The old regex-string patch needs a four-edition design and regression tests.

title: Multiple values pasting feature added to winnow_results method
note: The opt-in paste_multiple_values setting supports comma-, semicolon-, and tab-separated known values across all four editions; see fork PR #173 and Harvest #2845.

title: Implement the ability to search with true regexes
note: The opt-in search_matcher callback accepts application-supplied regex matching without changing the default literal search; see fork PR #155.

title: WIP: Add Coffeelint
note: This WIP adds an obsolete CoffeeLint configuration and a large formatting pass without a demonstrated behavior fix.

title: General touchup
note: This broad historical event-binding refactor has no isolated bug and conflicts with subsequent focus and event work in the fork.

title: use a tag instead of abbr tag for search-choice-close
note: The clear control now uses a button instead of the old abbr element, covering the markup concern in Harvest #495.

title: WIP: focus before selecting result
note: The current result handler retains search focus when a multiple select stays open and avoids refocusing a closed single select after selection.

title: add shortcut for deselect
note: Single deselection and keyboard removal are supported, including the documented Backspace behavior.

title: Make search match against text instead of html
note: The shared search matcher matches parsed option text rather than generated escaped HTML.

title: Make results_search run after keyup of Cmd key
note: Both classic adapters listen to input events, including edits made with Command-Delete.

title: Allow activated instance to be programatically opened
note: chosen:open can reopen an activated closed single select in both classic adapters; see fork PR #162 and Harvest #2689.

title: adds the ability to select all options under a group
note: Opt-in select_by_group makes multiple-select optgroup headings selectable across editions; see fork PR #171.

title: Allow for a transliteration callback
note: The normalize_search_text callback transforms queries and option labels for built-in matching, including transliteration.

title: Support for Fuzzy Searching Strings #2028 rebased against current master branch to fix merge conflict
note: An opt-in unordered substring-term search may add something beyond split_search_terms plus search_contains. The old patch mixes matching and HTML highlighting and needs a safe four-edition design.

title: Accessibility updates #264 - Add aria attributes to better support screen readers and keyboard navigation
note: Combobox and listbox roles, accessible state, and keyboard navigation are implemented and tested in the current fork.

title: Issue #2075: Fix client-side validation
note: Required native selects remain available for browser validation; the adapters preserve the source select as the form value and validation source.

title: Custom data-attributes for chosen generated options.
note: Opt-in data attribute passthrough from source options is available across the editions; see fork PR #187.

title: use inherit for width when offsetWidth is 0
note: Width calculation falls back to computed styles when a hidden select has zero offsetWidth; see the fork fixes for hidden select sizing.

title: Added event chosen:search
note: Chosen emits chosen:search and chosen:search_updated events for search interaction and result refreshes.

title: Support for home and end key
note: Home and End navigate results in both classic adapters, with Page Up and Page Down as well; see fork PR #132.

title: Update title and classnames (when option enabled) from select on update
note: chosen:updated mirrors the source title and refreshes inherited classes when enabled; see fork PRs #124 and #126.

title: Adding accessibility to chosen:
note: The current controls expose combobox/listbox roles, unique result identifiers, and ARIA selection state.

title: Add screen edge detection
note: Dropdown placement detects available space and supports opt-in positioning for clipped containers.

title: Accessible `<select>` elem solution
note: Keeping a second accessible native select alongside the custom combobox duplicates the control for assistive technology. The fork instead exposes accessible state on Chosen while retaining the original select for values and validation.

title: Add a way to do left bound word search to chosen for arbitrary word bounardies
note: A custom search_matcher can implement application-specific separators or word boundaries without adding an unsafe regex-string option.

title: SearchChoice pill: inherit classes on the option
note: Opt-in inherit_option_classes copies option classes to the selected pill.

title: Add CSS selector to make sure full placeholder text is visible after deselecting
note: The Sass selector already applies overflow and ellipsis rules to .chosen-single-with-deselect.chosen-default as well as ordinary single selects.

title: Ignore context (right click) mousedown events
note: Secondary-button presses no longer open closed jQuery, Prototype, Vanilla, or React controls. Adapter and real-browser regressions cover PR #201.

title: search_string_match testing
note: The old search_string_match test refactor targets a superseded test layout; the current matcher has shared core and adapter coverage.

title: added enable, disable and deselect
note: Applications can change native disabled or selected state and trigger chosen:updated; native values and events remain authoritative. Separate command events would duplicate that API.

title: Fixes position of invalid error flag on required selects - fixes #515
note: Required-select validation tooltip placement merits a current browser reproduction. The patch repositions the hidden native select on invalid, which may conflict with current focus and layout behavior.

title: Feature: Option adding (with custom callback)
note: Opt-in create_option adds to the native select and supports a callback, preserving the submitted value source.
